text_en: When we had parted from them and set sail, we came by a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
text_cn: 我们离别了他们，便开船一直航行，来到科斯，第二天到了洛多，又从那里到了帕塔辣。

text_en: When we found a ship bound for Phoenicia, we went on board and set sail.
text_cn: 我们遇见了一只要开往腓尼基的船，便上去航行。

text_en: We came in sight of Cyprus; and leaving it on our left, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, because the ship was to unload its cargo there.
text_cn: 我们望见了塞浦路斯，就从它左边驶过，向叙利亚驶去，在提洛靠了岸，因为船要在那里卸货。

text_en: We looked up the disciples and stayed there for seven days. Through the Spirit they told Paul not to go on to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 我们找到了门徒，就在那里住了七天；他们因圣神的默示，告诉保禄不要上耶路撒冷去。

text_en: When our days there were ended, we left and proceeded on our journey; and all of them, with wives and children, escorted us outside the city. There we knelt down on the beach and prayed
text_cn: 日子一满，我们便出发前行，众人同妻子儿女陪送我们直到城外；我们跪在岸上祈祷，

text_en: and said farewell to one another. Then we went on board the ship, and they returned home.
text_cn: 彼此辞别后，我们上了船，他们就回家去了。

text_en: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais; and we greeted the believers and stayed with them for one day.
text_cn: 我们从提洛到了仆托肋买，便行完了航程；向弟兄们请过安，就在他们那里住了一天。

text_en: The next day we left and came to Caesarea; and we went into the house of Philip the evangelist, one of the seven, and stayed with him.
text_cn: 第二天我们出发，来到凯撒勒雅，进了传福音者斐理伯的家，住在他那里，他是七执事之一。

text_en: He had four unmarried daughters who had the gift of prophecy.
text_cn: 他有四个女儿，都是贞女，能说预言。

text_en: While we were staying there for several days, a prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
text_cn: 我们住了多日。有一个先知，名叫阿加波，从犹太下来。

text_en: He came to us and took Paul’s belt, bound his own feet and hands with it, and said, “Thus says the Holy Spirit, ‘This is the way the Jews in Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt and will hand him over to the Gentiles. ’”
text_cn: 他来到我们这里，拿起保禄的腰带，将自己的脚和手绑了，说：“圣神这样说：犹太人要在耶路撒冷这样捆绑这条腰带的主人，将他交在外邦人手中。”

text_en: When we heard this, we and the people there urged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 我们一听这话，就同当地居民请求保禄不要上耶路撒冷去。

text_en: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound but even to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus. ”
text_cn: 保禄回答说：“你们为什么啼哭，使我心碎呢？为了主耶稣的名，我不但准备受捆绑，而且也准备死在耶路撒冷。”

text_en: Since he would not be persuaded, we remained silent except to say, “The Lord’s will be done. ”
text_cn: 我们既不能说服他，也就静默了，只说：“愿主的旨意成就罢！”

text_en: After these days we got ready and started to go up to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 过了几天，我们便收拾行李上耶路撒冷去；

text_en: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also came along and brought us to the house of Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we were to stay.
text_cn: 有几个凯撒勒雅的门徒，也和我们同去，他们领我们到一个久为门徒的塞浦路斯人木纳松那里住宿。

text_en: When we arrived in Jerusalem, the brothers welcomed us warmly.
text_cn: 我们到了耶路撒冷，弟兄们高兴地接待了我们。

text_en: The next day Paul went with us to visit James; and all the elders were present.
text_cn: 第二天，保禄同我们去见雅各伯，众长老也都聚集在那里。

text_en: After greeting them, he related one by one the things that God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.
text_cn: 保禄向他们请安以后，就将天主在外邦人中藉他的服务所行的事，一一叙述了。

text_en: When they heard it, they praised God. Then they said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands of believers there are among the Jews, and they are all zealous for the law.
text_cn: 他们听了，就光荣天主，并对保禄说：“弟兄！你看，在信教的犹太人中盈千累万，都是热爱法律的人；

text_en: They have been told about you that you teach all the Jews living among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, and that you tell them not to circumcise their children or observe the customs.
text_cn: 关于你，他们听说你教训在外邦人中的一切犹太人背弃梅瑟，说不要给孩子行割损礼，也不要按规例行。

text_en: What then is to be done? They will certainly hear that you have come.
text_cn: 那么怎么办呢？他们总会听说你已来了。

text_en: So do what we tell you. We have four men who are under a vow.
text_cn: 你就按照我们告诉你的去办罢：我们这里有四个人，他们都有愿在身；

text_en: Join these men, go through the rite of purification with them, and pay for the shaving of their heads. Thus all will know that there is nothing in what they have been told about you, but that you yourself observe and guard the law.
text_cn: 你带这些人，同他们一起行取洁礼，并替他们出钱，叫他们剃头；这样，众人便知道自己关于你所听到的事原是假的，而你却是个循规蹈矩，遵守法律的人。

text_en: But as for the Gentiles who have become believers, we have sent a letter with our judgment that they should abstain from what has been sacrificed to idols and from blood and from what is strangled and from fornication. ”
text_cn: 关于信教的外邦人，我们已写信决定，叫他们戒避祭邪神之物、血、窒死的禽兽和奸淫。”

text_en: Then Paul took the men, and the next day, having purified himself, he entered the temple with them, making public the completion of the days of purification when the sacrifice would be made for each of them.
text_cn: 于是保禄就把这几个人带去；第二天，同他们一起行了取洁礼，以后进了圣殿，呈报取洁的日子何时满期，何时为他们每人奉献供物。

text_en: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, who had seen him in the temple, stirred up the whole crowd. They seized him,
text_cn: 当七天快完时，从亚细亚来的犹太人见保禄在殿里，就煽动所有的群众，向他下手，

text_en: shouting, “Fellow Israelites, help! This is the man who is teaching everyone everywhere against our people, our law, and this place; more than that, he has actually brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place. ”
text_cn: 喊着说：“以色列人！请帮忙，这就是到处教训众人反对人民、法律和这地方的那个人。他还领了希腊人们进圣殿，亵渎了这圣地。”

text_en: For they had previously seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
text_cn: 原来他们以前见过厄弗所人特洛斐摩同他在城里，就以为保禄领他进了圣殿。

text_en: Then all the city was aroused, and the people rushed together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple, and immediately the doors were shut.
text_cn: 于是全城震动，百姓一起跑来，拿住保禄，把他拉出殿外，立即把门都关上。

text_en: While they were trying to kill him, word came to the tribune of the cohort that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
text_cn: 他们正想要杀他时，有人上去报告给营部的千夫长说：“全耶路撒冷都乱了！”

text_en: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. When they saw the tribune and the soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.
text_cn: 千夫长立时带着士兵和百夫长跑下来，到了他们那里；他们一见了千夫长和士兵，就停止，不打保禄了。

text_en: Then the tribune came, arrested him, and ordered him to be bound with two chains; he inquired who he was and what he had done.
text_cn: 于是千夫长前去，拿住保禄，下令用两条锁链绑了，遂查问他是谁，作了什么事。

text_en: Some in the crowd shouted one thing, some another; and as he could not learn the facts because of the uproar, he ordered him to be brought into the barracks.
text_cn: 群众中，有的喊这，有的喊那；由于乱嚷，千夫长不能得知实情，便下令将保禄带到营里去。

text_en: When Paul came to the steps, the violence of the mob was so great that he had to be carried by the soldiers.
text_cn: 当走上台阶时，由于群众挤得凶猛，保禄只好由士兵抬着；

text_en: The crowd that followed kept shouting, “Away with him! ”
text_cn: 一群百姓跟在后面喊着说：“除掉他！”

text_en: Just as Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he said to the tribune, “May I say something to you? ” The tribune replied, “Do you know Greek?
text_cn: 快要带进营盘时，保禄向千夫长说：“许我向你说句话吗？”他说：“你会希腊话？

text_en: Then you are not the Egyptian who recently stirred up a revolt and led the four thousand assassins out into the wilderness? ”
text_cn: 莫非你就是前些日子作乱，带领四千匕首党人，往荒野去的那个埃及人吗？”

text_en: Paul replied, “I am a Jew, from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of an important city; I beg you, let me speak to the people. ”
text_cn: 保禄答说：“我是犹太人，是塔尔索人，基里基雅的一个并非无名城市的公民。我求你，准我向百姓讲话。”

text_en: When he had given him permission, Paul stood on the steps and motioned to the people for silence; and when there was a great hush, he addressed them in the Hebrew language, saying:
text_cn: 千夫长准许了；保禄就站在台阶上向百姓挥手，大家都安静下来后，保禄便用希伯来话致辞说：
